title: Blueprints: checklists that expand a ticket into everything it really needs
description: Planning philosophy (docs/product-vision.md): a 'Header' ticket implies logo, menu, burger menu on mobile vs. navigation on desktop, states, accessibility, data contracts. Reusable, project-local blueprints (e.g. ui-component/header, service, form, page) suggest child tickets, acceptance criteria and code-plan entries when a ticket is created or reviewed; pman check / pman next can warn when a ticket of a known kind lacks expected parts. Agents and people can add their own blueprints in .pman/blueprints/.
